extraction_notes: The supplied PDF is the manufacturer datasheet AOD66923, Rev.1.0: April 2018; all six pages were examined.
The datasheet identifies the device as a 100 V N-channel MOSFET. The electrical-characteristics heading states TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
Threshold voltage was preserved as separate minimum, typical, and maximum values at ID = 250 uA and VDS = VGS.
Every published RDS(on) row was transcribed, including typical and maximum values at VGS = 10 V and 4.5 V, and the separate TJ = 125 degC row.
The capacitance table values were converted from pF to F and retain the published VGS = 0 V, VDS = 50 V, and f = 1 MHz conditions.

The datasheet also publishes IDSS maxima of 1 uA at TJ = 25 degC and 5 uA at TJ = 55 degC, IGSS maximum of +/-100 nA at VDS = 0 V and VGS = +/-20 V, Rg min/typ/max of 0.3/0.8/1.3 ohm at f = 1 MHz, gate-charge values, switching times, thermal resistances, and avalanche ratings; these fields are not representable in the strict schema.
Curve points are conservative manual digitizations of visible plotted grid locations only; no values were interpolated or extrapolated beyond the displayed traces.

Figure 8 capacitance curves have clear axes and traces, but the figure itself does not print frequency or temperature; the related electrical-characteristics table specifies f = 1 MHz for the capacitance measurements.
